name: AIMail
description: Receive AIMail at your agent addresses: each thread lands in its own PI-Desktop session, and a mail is acknowledged only after the host accepted it.
author: AIMail

settings.title: Gateway URL
settings.description: Base URL of your AIMail gateway, e.g. https://mail.example.com

settings.title: Gateway API key
settings.description: The address's admin key. Stored in this plugin's settings file, which the host keeps in plain text until secure storage exists.

settings.title: GatewaySystemId
settings.description: Identifies the gateway installation. One pull stream runs per (AgentSystemId, Gateway).

settings.title: AgentSystemId (optional)
settings.description: Aggregate every address of this agent system into one stream. Leave empty to pull the address-scoped queue.

settings.title: Address (optional)
settings.description: Your aimail address, used in the log line for each delivery.

settings.title: Project id (optional)
settings.description: Host project that imported sessions belong to. Numeric id from the host, never a path.

settings.title: Poll interval (seconds)
settings.description: How long to hold each pull request. Dedicated mailboxes are cheap to poll; the default is 30.
